svg.title: FrontierHarness Eval: pass rate and reported median cost per task
svg.desc: a13n is an unranked local run with unresolved timing comparability. It passed 21 of 30 tasks, with a reported median task cost of $0.4137; complete raw usage is available for 22 tasks. Baseline medians use available canonical first-cold costs, including failures. Hollow baseline points have missing task costs. The table also reports cost per pass as a separate metric.
svg.text: USD · logarithmic scale · available task costs

g.data-note: Reported estimates for 30 tasks; complete raw usage for 22/30. Nine unknown-usage requests excluded. DeepSWE time limits unverified.
g.title: a13n Harness: 21/30 passed · $0.4137 median/task · $2.9254/pass. Reported estimates for 30 tasks; complete raw usage for 22/30. Nine unknown-usage requests excluded. DeepSWE time limits unverified.
